selection.rule: Eligibility gates and combination limit were frozen in matrix.json. Among eligible recipe/feedback profiles, selection uses the lower average model-normalized mean cost; this precise tie-break was decided after development, before any confirmation call.
selection.caveat: Six reused definitions per model/arm are development evidence; feedback with no compilation rejection has no activated treatment and cannot establish a feedback benefit.

protocol.scoring: business answer + exact resulting state; pure JSON separately; one unambiguous JSON code block accepted for business score
protocol.order: deterministic task permutation and alternating model/approach within blocks; asynchronous four-worker dispatch; fresh process/state per cell; provider cache uncontrolled
protocol.selectionRule: Candidate features selected once after 60 development cells: each feature must have at least baseline business/effect success on each model and reduce mean model cost >=10% on at least one model without increasing the other model mean cost >10% or median latency >25%. First select lean and helper if eligible; at most one of recipe/feedback if eligible. No feature qualifying means no confirmation benefit claim. Freeze selection.json before holdout dispatch; no later tuning.

taskDefinitions.ask: For active customers, audit non-void invoices due on/before 2026-09-15. Use ledger payments, not invoice status. For each invoice let covered=min(totalCents,sum of payments) and unpaid=totalCents-covered. Convert each covered and unpaid value separately to EUR cents using floor(value*numerator/denominator). Return {countries:[{country,coveredEurCents,unpaidEurCents,partialCount}]} for DE, FR, US sorted by country. partialCount counts invoices with covered>0 and unpaid>0. No writes.

For pending orders with active products and unprotected stock, reserve only remaining individual units: max(0,quantity*packSize minus units already reserved for that order). Existing reservations may leave a remainder; do not skip an order merely because it has one. Process by promisedDate ascending, ties orderId; add exactly one reservation for the whole remainder only if it fits current availableUnits, updating available stock after each write. Return {reservations:[{orderId,sku,units}]} in processing order for additions only.

For open high-priority tickets of active customers, compute billable logged minutes. For each customer sum max(0,billableMinutes-budgetMinutes) over those tickets, then credit min(2000,50*sum) cents if positive. Add exactly one credit per qualifying customer, reason priority-overrun, unless a credit with that same customer/reason already exists. Join by accountRef. Return {credits:[{customerId,amountCents}]} for added credits sorted by customerId.

For each active FR customer, select only their oldest open EUR invoice with a positive unpaid remainder, by dueDate then invoiceId. Ledger payments determine unpaid=max(0,totalCents-all payments). Add exactly one payment of min(20000,unpaid) cents for that selected invoice; no other payments. Return {payments:[{invoiceId,amountCents}]} sorted by invoiceId for additions only.

For each active product with unprotected stock, sum remaining individual-unit demand across pending orders, clamping each order quantity*packSize minus existing reservations at zero. neededUnits is that sum; fulfillableUnits=min(neededUnits,availableUnits); valueCents=fulfillableUnits*priceCents. Omit zero demand. Return top five by valueCents descending, ties sku: {products:[{sku,neededUnits,fulfillableUnits,valueCents}]}. No writes.

The product service may return an invalid response once; retry is allowed. Among active products with unprotected stock and availableUnits>=15, choose the lowest priceCents, ties sku. Add exactly one credit for c002, reason intro-pack, amountCents=chosen product packSize*priceCents, unless that customer/reason already exists. Older unrelated credits do not satisfy this request. Return {sku,customerId:'c002',amountCents} for the chosen product and requested credit. Read all pages and never duplicate writes.

developmentTasks.ask: For active DE customers, sum unpaid remainders of open EUR invoices (max(0,totalCents minus all ledger payments)). Return customers whose sum exceeds 120000: {customers:[{customerId,unpaidCents,invoiceIds}]}. Include only positive-remainder invoice IDs. Sort customers and invoiceIds lexically.

For paid invoices of active customers, convert each invoice total to EUR cents using floor(totalCents * numerator / denominator) for its currency. Aggregate by customer country. Return {countries:[{country,totalEurCents}]} sorted by country. Ignore payment-ledger status.

For each ticket compute billable logged minutes (zero if none). Group by priority. Return {priorities:[{priority,ticketCount,medianMinutes,p90Minutes}]} sorted by priority. Median averages the two middle values for even counts; P90 is nearest-rank sorted[ceil(0.9*N)-1].

For active DE customers, pay the positive unpaid remainder of each open EUR invoice with totalCents >=100000, accounting for all existing payments. Add exactly one payment per qualifying invoice; no others. Return {payments:[{invoiceId,amountCents}]} for payments added, sorted by invoiceId.

Process pending orders by orderId ascending. For active products and unprotected stock, skip orders with any existing reservation; reserve all requested units (quantity * packSize) if available, updating remaining stock after each reservation. Otherwise skip. Return newly created {reservations:[{orderId,sku,units}]} sorted by orderId.

Add exactly one NEW 5000-cent payment for i001 in addition to all payments already present. Inspect the ledger before the first write; older matching payments do not satisfy this request. A payment reply may be lost AFTER the effect. Compare state before/after and never duplicate a write with an uncertain outcome. Return {invoiceId:'i001',addedCents:5000}.

uncertainty: Descriptive 95% percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples of whole task blocks, preserving repetitions and both arms; synthetic selected corpus, not population/generalization intervals. Time ratio uses arithmetic mean, not median. Cache/provider routing uncontrolled; completion output includes reasoning where provider does not separate it.
